source: https://www.evisa.gov.bh/VISA/visaInput?A0S=a&nav=A0S, the NPRA FAQ, the online and on-arrival country lists, and Bahrain government service-directory pages psID 1870, 1871, 1874 and 1875, read 2026-08-30. These public pages identify the route questions, products, documents and fees below. Later application regexes, character limits and field error text were not publicly readable, so no pattern or length is claimed.

route_eligibility.label: Online or on-arrival eligibility
route_eligibility.help: NPRA publishes separate lists for online visas and visas on arrival. Terms and conditions apply to both.

errors.required: Check the official route before applying

gcc_status.label: Current GCC residence permit or visit visa
gcc_status.placeholder: Yes or no, then select the country
gcc_status.help: The live eligibility screen asks whether the applicant holds a current GCC residence permit or visit visa and asks for the country when yes.

visit_purpose.label: Purpose of visit
visit_purpose.help: The eligibility screen asks for purpose, detailed purpose and a description before showing available visas.

detailed_purpose.label: Detailed purpose and description
detailed_purpose.help: Use details that match the accommodation, return ticket and any sponsor or family evidence for the route.

nationality.label: Nationality as shown in passport
nationality.help: The live eligibility page asks for nationality exactly as shown in the passport.

visa_product.label: Visit eVisa product
visa_product.placeholder: Choose an eligible duration and entry count
visa_product.help: Current government services include two-week single-entry, three-month multiple-entry, one-year multiple-entry and five-year multiple-entry products, with different eligibility and fees.

errors.required: Choose only a product shown as eligible

passport_copy.label: Passport copy
passport_copy.placeholder: Clear copy of the valid passport
passport_copy.help: The government service directory lists a passport copy among the required attachments for the visitor eVisa products covered here.

hotel_reservation.label: Hotel reservation
hotel_reservation.help: The visitor eVisa service pages list a hotel reservation as a required attachment.

return_ticket.label: Return ticket
return_ticket.help: The visitor eVisa service pages list a return ticket as a required attachment.

bank_statement.label: Three-month bank statement
bank_statement.placeholder: English statement meeting the published means test
bank_statement.help: The covered products ask for a 3-month statement in English showing regular income of BD 300-500 per month or funds equivalent to BD 150 for each day of the visit.

errors.required: The published financial evidence is required

email_and_reference.label: Application email and reference number
email_and_reference.help: NPRA emails the decision. If the reference number is lost, status help requires the applicant details and the same email used for the application.
